run_dm_control_explorer: run the DM Control Suite environment explorer with an interactive viewer
run_explorer_with_environment: run the explorer for a specific domain.task environment like walker.walk
run_explorer_with_action_noise: run the explorer with Gaussian action noise applied to environment actions
run_explorer_without_timeout: run the explorer with no episode time limit for unlimited interaction
run_explorer_visualize_reward: run the explorer with reward visualization coloring geoms by reward value
